notes.title: The Anniversary Update is Available Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to The Anniversary Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40443391/d5f4c21a01e84366bb9b948d1b855360e83a95ef.png[/img]

Earlier last month, we celebrated the one-year anniversary of Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered's release here on Steam. It's been a wonderful year, and our team is very proud of all of the content we've been able to dish out for the game over the course of that year. This includes the Further Descent Update, The Superior Reign Update, Winter Update, and all of those smaller updates in between that have improved our game's experience. We want to thank all of our players for supporting our first major indie release here on Steam and we are thrilled to share more information about our future plans. Till then, we give you the final update for Maguntsche Remastered.


[h2]Update [0.4.0] Patch Notes [/h2]


[h3]New Difficulty Options & Demonic Mode for Maguntsche Mode![/h3]
We are introducing a variety of new difficulty options for Maguntsche Mode, one of which includes Demonic mode. This new difficulty mode introduces new game mechanics and instant death scenarios designed for players looking for a new challenge! Each difficulty mode increases the speed, damage, and time duration between objectives. We look forward to seeing players try these new options out!

[h3]New Volume 3 of The Maguntsche Archives![/h3]
Explore an all new addition to the archives. Three college friends return to their hometown of Macungie, Pennsylvania, for the holidays. During a town-wide new years celebration, discoveries are made, and chaos brews. The Superior's grip on the town tightens. Will Ian, Logan, and Sarah be able to withstand its new recruits or will they become the latest victims of the dark forces infiltrating this small town?

[h3] New Superior Mode Challenges![/h3]
We've added the new Breakneck Quietus Challenge to Superior Mode! This new challenge reflects the new Demonic difficulty mode in Maguntsche Mode. Players can now experience a new instant-death scenario with higher reward stakes! This will be the last new challenge added to Superior Mode.

[h3]New Achievements![/h3]
In addition to the visual overhaul of our achievements, we are also introducing some new achievements for players to collect regarding some of the new difficulty options we've added to Maguntsche Mode.

[h3]New Changes to Archives Collection System[/h3]
A complete pass of the original archives system has been reworked. Players will now be able to universally and passively collect archive entries in both Maguntsche Mode and Superior Mode. Unlocking the third volume of the Maguntsche archives requires the player to complete the first two volumes.


[h3]Quality of Life Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a Death-Cinematics System for The Maguntsche Demon
[*]Added Vertical Synchronization Options
[*]Added Frame Rate Caps while in Menus
[*]Improved Player Head-Bobbing Mechanics
[*]Improved Main Menu Visuals
[*]Improved HUD Status Indicator Icons
[*]Improved HUD & UI Scaling
[*]Improved In-Game Objective Descriptions
[*]Improved Dust Particle Effects
[*]Improved Post Processing Effects & Fog Density Settings
[*]Fixed Infinite Loading Screen Bugs
[*]Fixed Superior Mode Challenge Modifier Button Interact-ability Conditions Bug
[*]Fixed "Quit To Menu" Button Functionality in Superior Mode
[*]Fixed Don't Touch That! Achievement Win Conditions
[*]Fixed Interface Scaling Bug on Initial Brightness Setup Screen
[*]Fixed Invisible Reality Fragments Spawn Variants Bug in Maguntsche Mode
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Balancing Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased The Maguntsche Demon's Speed Difficulty Modifier in Superior Mode by 66%
[*]Increased The Maguntsche Demon's Frenzy Difficulty Modifier in Superior Mode by 100% 
[*]Decreased Sleep Deprivation Score Modifier Value to [+50% -> -25%]
[*]Decreased Score Value of Frenzy Survival Event in Superior Mode [500 -> 300]
[*]Increased Score Value of Disorientation Even in Superior Mode [25 -> 50]
[/list]


[h2]A Message From The Lead Developer[/h2]

"Hello everyone! My name is Kaleb Wassa. While speaking on the behalf of our team, we are all very thankful for the support we've gotten from players and contributors that have helped us shape this project over the past year. It had always been a dream of mine to publish a game here on the Steam platform and that vision was achieved last summer. Since then, I've learned a great deal about what it means to be an indie game developer and how to improve my communication and planning abilities. Without the members of our team, our players, and my close friends this game would not be where it is today. I wanted to personally thank everyone because this has been a life changing experience and I am thrilled for what the future entails for this series and for myself. Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered will be a free-to-play title here on Steam as a token of my appreciation for all of the gamers and friends and contributors that helped shape this project into what it is today. If necessary, I will be releasing smaller patches for bugs and other issues that may arise in the future. If that is not the case, This is goodbye...for now!"

Best Regards,

Kaleb Wassa
Lead Producer

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40443391/d5c920ca428c610045ff6dce0d10bff67da6e9d7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40443391/36ff6dc8888b50f324762369979abe5e50a17556.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Small Update [0.3.2] is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this small update is primarily focusing on quality-of-life improvements and fixing some bugs. We hope you enjoy some of these small changes. The week-long discount has also ended, but we are planning new discounts in the future! Below you can see a summary of changes in this update.


[u]New Features & Improvements[/u]

[list]
[*] Updated the Main Menu with a new environment and implemented audio track transitions for the Maguntsche Mode and Superior Mode.

[*] Updated Maguntsche Mode's in-game description, removed outdated tutorial.

[*] Added a button shortcut to Maguntsche: Chapter Two's page on our official website.

[*] We implemented a major change to the random seed generation algorithm that should result in a greater variety of level combinations and randomness which will ultimately improve the experience of both Maguntsche and Superior Mode.

[*] Implemented some small changes to the lower quality graphic settings which may provide a small boost in performance to low-end systems. Some of these changes include reducing particle ray casting budgets and shadow distances.

[/list]


[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the same difficulty buff to be applied to the Maguntsche Demon's stats when reaching time milestones in Superior Mode.

[*] Fixed an issue that resulted in the game generating the same level variant combination every match in Maguntsche Mode. You should now find more unique level combinations and better replay-ability.

[*] Fixed an exploitative issue that caused the Maguntsche Demon to be slowed down by the flashlight even when disabled using the Total Darkness challenge modifier in Superior Mode.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]

We are still investing a potential memory leak issue with Superior Mode that progressively gets worse as the player gains score. Please be aware that the game will crash and could potentially cause other issues with your system. Our hope is to diagnose the issue soon and to release another patch within the next couple of weeks.

There is an issue with scene transitions that results in infinite loading. This doesn't happen too often, but it has been replicated throughout most scene transitions. We are investigating the issue and will hopefully have a fix soon.

notes.title: The Winter Quality of Life Update is Here!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone! Today we celebrate a huge milestone for Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered. As the year comes to an end, we look back at all of the amazing content updates we've released this year. The Further Descent Update and The Superior Reign Update were our primary focuses of this year, adding new features and replay-ability for players. To end the year, we are closing with a massive quality of life update that polishes up some of the game's loose ends and untouched features. Below, we've compiled a list of important changes we think you should know about.

[b] Major Graphics Update[/b]

We've finally finished updating the game's environments with the new assets we introduced in The Superior Reign update. In addition to these changes in the environment is improvements to the game's lighting and post processing effects. The Maguntsche Demon's model has also been completely update with new geometry and textures to improve artistic consistency. We've also added some new effects to the Realmverse, you should notice some new fog effects in both Maguntsche Mode and Superior Mode.

[b]Improvements to Maguntsche Demon Behavior[/b]

You'll notice some differences in the Maguntsche Demon's behavior. Aside from some of the balancing changes we've made, you'll notice some differences in his animations as well. In the future, we want to explore adding new animations to better communicate his current state.

[b]Added New Superior Mode Challenges[/b]

We added some new challenges to Superior Mode for you to try out! The Speed Demon challenge increases the Maguntsche Demon's default movement speed from the start and increases his speed buffs when the player reaches a time milestone. Face of Unfathomable Horrors increases the glitch effects on screen when looking at the Maguntsche Demon and slightly drains your health.

[b]Added Loading Screens[/b]

While this doesn't sound like much of an improvement, it will better help users and developers determine what the game is doing between loading various different scenes in the Unity game engine. This will make it easier to identify potential issues where the game might hang or not reach a specific scene.

[b]Added Brightness Setup Screen[/b]

Upon loading the game for the first time, the player will now be met with a screen for them to tune their brightness. Brightness settings have been improved and can still be adjusted both in the menu and in-game.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented End-Game Conditions being met when player falls through level hazards
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player to blink before level transition was made in Superior Mode
[*] Fixed an issue that slowed the Maguntsche Demon down even if the players flashlight was dead
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented accessibility to kitchen in Superior Mode levels
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the FX volume to be lowered when adjusting Music volume levels
[*] Fixed an issue that adjusted the Ambient Light for a scene instead of Gamma
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player's Steam account profile image to not display on main menu
[/list]

[b]Balancing & Other Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Decreased Initial Time Milestone Timer By 66%
[*] Decreased Time Milestone Increase  By 40%
[*] Decreased Outlast Score Event Bonus Gain By 22%
[*] Increased Fragment Finder Score Event Points By 18%
[*] Increased Maguntsche Demon's Milestone Speed Modifier By 100%
[*] Increased Maguntsche Demon's Milestone Strength Modifier By 40%
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added New Contributors in game credits
[*] Disabled Particle Burn Effects for Flashlight Mechanics
[*] Added New Splash Screen for GlassDev Entertainment
[*] Updated Ending Screens with New Art Assets
[/list]

notes.title: The Winter Quality of Life Update is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/2b0c3f36944741055fa51acc1d12b9945a7a3a4e.png[/img]

As the year is coming to an end, we wanted to celebrate the season with some new quality of life improvements for Maguntsche: Chapter One. Our team has expanded quite significantly, and we are all dedicated to delivery quality improvements that will improve our game's experience for players both old and new. The Winter Quality of Life Update will be releasing on December 22, 2021! Now that's out of the bag, I wanted to do a quick overview of some of the things we've been working on.


[b]Winter Quality of Life Update Highlights[/b]

-Added Three New Challenges to Superior Mode

-Improved Visuals for Environments (Graphics Overhaul for Maguntsche Mode is [u]Complete![/u])

-Improved Visuals for Maguntsche Demon and Animations

-Experimental Rework of Maguntsche Archives Mechanics for Maguntsche Mode.

-Additional Settings & Improved Control over Audio, Brightness, and Post Processing Effects.

-Improved User Interfaces & Visual Feedback

-Various Bug Fixes & Balances (More Details Coming Soon)


We will have more details regarding all of these great improvements in the future. On launch day you'll find more detailed documentation on these changes in our patch notes here on Steam. With that in mind, we wanted to give players some hints about stuff we're planning for the new year. After the release of this QOL update, we will begin shifting our focus to next year's major content update.


[b]Information About Next Year's Content Update[/b]

One thing we've learned from our players is that the onboarding experience can be difficult at times. Next year's content update will feature a revamped tutorial and a brand new cinematic experience that will better draw players into the universe of the Maguntsche Series. We believe this new experience will encourage players to complete secondary objectives through the Maguntsche Archives, which will also be redesigned to provide better rewards and incentives to players. Everything is still in the early design phases and we don't want to reveal too many details, but we'll have more information after the release of The Winter Quality of Life Update. Till then, stay tuned!


Best Regards,

The GlassDev Entertainment Team

notes.title: The Superior Reign Update is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/4c3481d9820be7202c05fb92845ccada965b737f.png[/img]

Happy Halloween everyone! In this month, three years ago, the original Maguntsche: Chapter One game was released. To celebrate this milestone, we're releasing a major update to add some new exciting content and experiences into this remastered experience. With the addition of new team members, the future of Maguntsche Remastered is brighter than ever. Below, we have a list of changes and improvements for you to explore! Thank you again for all of your support!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/115545d3f88856ccacf445beb5c329ec7238dc9f.png[/img]

[h3]Introducing Superior Mode![/h3]
Superior Mode is an all-new arcade-styled game mode that allows players to customize their experience with unique challenges. This endless game mode comes with its own set of environments that have also been updated in part with our visual overhaul of the game's assets. Superior Mode has a dedicated scoring system and statistics tracking. These new mechanics work with some other neat additions in this update!

[h3]Leaderboard Integration[/h3]
To use the new leaderboard features, you must have a Steam account and be connected to the internet. However, these features are not required to play Superior Mode. Your username is automatically grabbed from Steam, and your highest score will be automatically uploaded to our systems. By enabling different challenges, you can boost your score modifier and ultimately raise your chance of reaching the top of the leaderboard.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/26c40bca478085d873ce628ac3f53fa185f37a6b.png[/img]

[h3]Volume Two of The Maguntsche Archives & Completion Reward[/h3]
To celebrate the Halloween season, we are releasing a new volume of the archives. Entries for volume two can only be earned through playing Superior Mode. Once completing this new story, you can unlock an exclusive seasonal cosmetic for the enemies of Superior Mode! Entries to the first volume of the game can still be collected via Maguntsche Mode.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/4a6dfbe772306c01a1fe53ec468771d5b9d15d4a.png[/img]

[h3]Art Assets Overhaul[/h3]
We have been working extensively to update the assets of the game in their entirety. However, this proved to be a more time-consuming task. Some of the environments are partially corrected, but you may encounter some style inconsistencies, primarily in Maguntsche Mode. We plan on iterating on these changes with the second part of this update later this month. There is a chance you may encounter some bugs or visual issues in Maguntsche Mode as well, but be reminded that we are planning on polishing these changes later this month with feedback from players.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/1a35b9210f157d15432efc5eb4312b6068e3bb3a.png[/img]

[h3]Game Performance Optimizations[/h3]
We've reworked the graphics scaling between settings to provide additional performance improvements on lower quality settings. An advanced decal system has also been implemented to improve the performance of Realmverse environments. This new decal system also allows us to design environments quicker. We are still exploring more options in the future to make the game more accessible to a larger audience of players.

[h3]Overhauled Settings Menu & New Options[/h3]
We've also implemented new quality of life improvements for this update. While also simplifying the display method for the game's settings, we've added V-Sync options and a unique setting that allows the player to enable or disable the pixelation camera effect of the game. In the future, we want to explore more ways that the player can customize the game's visuals.

[h3]New User Interface Additions[/h3]
We've added some additions to Maguntsche Mode's user interface. You can now find a display that communicates the player's current objective on the top of the screen. We hope this provides additional clarity to players early in the game.


[h3]Other Changes Include...[/h3]

[list]
[*]Updated Main Menu with new visuals and music
[*]Added a new custom mouse cursor
[*]Temporarily Disabled some Environment Interactions
[*]Improved Post Processing Profiles for both Normalverse & Realmverse environments
[*]Added Restart Buttons to Death Screens
[*] Several Performance / Optimization Improvements
[*] Additional Improvements to Tutorials Section
[*] Small UI Improvements
[/list]

notes.title: The Superior Reign Update is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/4c3481d9820be7202c05fb92845ccada965b737f.png[/img]

The Superior Reign Update is nearly here! Our largest update will be launching its first iteration next week on October 24, 2021. This update will include the majority of changes we are pushing towards players. This includes an all new custom game mode, leader-board mechanics, and a new seasonal archive to explore. You'll also see that the team is busy at work updating some of the game's art assets. You'll find some of the game's art has been updated. This task proved to be extremely challenging and time consuming, so it is taking us longer than expected to release. That's why a second iteration of the Superior Reign update will be released on October 31, 2021. This will top-off a lot of the work we've been doing on updating the game's assets. We remain open to any feedback or criticism and will continue to improve upon the game's art as we move forward. To recap, I've put some critical points below with information on both of the updates this month.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/63ff51c74d95157c86f30355c7625a0d20d602f6.png[/img]

[h3]Superior Reign Update Part 1 [October 24, 2021] [/h3]
[list]
[*] All New Custom Game-Mode (Superior Mode) w/ Unique Challenges and Score System
[*] Leader-board Mechanics
[*] Seasonal Archives Event
[*] Partial Graphics Update
[*] Additional Game Settings
[/list]

[h3]Superior Reign Update Part 2 [October 31, 2021] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional Graphics Updates
[*] High Priority Balances for Superior Mode
[*] Other Bug Fixes & Improvements
[/list]

As we approach the anniversary of the original game's launch, the team and I look with optimism with what we have in store for this update. It was always our intention to add more replay-ability to the game after launch. While the Further Descent update added some small improvements to the initial game mode, this update will be adding a completely unique experience never seen before in any other entries in the series. See you all shortly!

notes.title: The Further Descent Update is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/496462e0f5afaa9e590fa5f05a2cca4c2e3570eb.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/581ce5a314b9f2803892f7dfa513d8b518000be5.png[/img]

Hello everyone, today I am proud to announce that The Further Descent update for Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered is nearly here! The update will be available to the public starting at midnight on Tuesday (August 24, 2021) [EST]. Since release, we've been hard at work adding new quality of life improvements and features to improve the overall user experience. To celebrate, you can also get your copy of the game at a discounted price all week long! This update is packed with a ton of new changes and improvements. So let's get into them!


[h3]Level Variability[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/46fb71e3d35c20aac90731e759033f6113b467d9.png[/img]

As a first in the series, you can now experience up to 26 different level combinations every time you load into the game! This not only provides some replay-ability to the game, but also increases the spawn location variety of archive entries by 120%. Many of these new iterations have environmental hazards, so it was important that we provide you with a new flashlight as well.

[h3]New Flashlight Mechanics & Improved Interface[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/de93a13fca610d5bfbd75df6c6aaac0a01e2c3d2.png[/img]

In addition to an increase in battery life, the flashlight can now be used to slow down the Maguntsche Demon temporarily. This is of course at the expense of charging his frenzy ability more quickly. This new defensive mechanism should buy the player sometime in-between world transitions. The user interface has also been given some improvements both in the menus and in-game. The player HUD now has a flashlight battery indicator, as well as a new dial that better communicates the charge level of the Maguntsche Demon.

[h3]New Tutorial Section[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/739818378b4914f86c6cc49c462aca262becaf30.png[/img]

As part of our UI changes, we've also gone and implemented a polished tutorial section that breaks down the user interface in-game. This section will also provide some new hints and tips regarding the newly added randomized level iterations. We plan to build on this new system in future releases to allow further insight into new game modes coming in the future.

[h2]Other New Changes Include...[/h2]


[h3]New Environment Interactions[/h3]

You can now interact with select objects in-game. These interactions allow you to better explore your environment as well as reveal additional story elements. We want to continue to build on this system in future updates and would like some user feedback regarding these simple interactions.

[h3]New In-Game Settings Menu[/h3]

You can now change most of the game's settings from within the pause menu, this was done to eliminate the player from having to enter and leave a game to adjust settings comfortably.

[h3]Added Six New Achievements[/h3]

We've gone ahead and added some new achievements surrounding the Further Descent update. Most of these new achievements provide new challenges to the player and will test your abilities. Some of these new achievements are secret ones as well!

[h3]New Visual Enhancements[/h3]

This includes new graphics in our menus, new textures and materials in the game environment, as well as improvements to fog gradients, lighting, and reflection maps. The onscreen pixel density has been slightly increased to provide more clarity. You can also find some additional decorative elements throughout the game.

[h3]Additional Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]

Other small improvements, such as a restart button in the death screen will prevent the player from having to navigate through the main menu to jump back into a game. We have a better breakdown of these bug fixes and improvements below:

[u]Bug Fixes & Small Additions:[/u]

-Fixed Maguntsche Demon spawning on Staircase Bug

-Fixed Collider Bug on all rug objects

-Fixed Text Consistency Issues

-Fixed Spamming Landing Sound Effect bug

-Reduced Player Controller jitteriness

-Added new Button Click FX

-Added new Footsteps FX 

[u][b]Known Issue[/b][/u] - Rare Occasion where 1 of 2 Documents doesn't spawn
(We are looking into this and will provide a hotfix as soon as possible)


[u]Gameplay Balances:[/u]

-Increased FOV while running

-Increased Document Spawn Location Variability by 120%

-Increased Footstep Volume by 40%

-Reduced Blink Animation time by 25%

-Reduced Maguntsche Demon's Frenzy Duration by 33%

-Increased Maguntsche Demons' End-Game Speed by 16%

-Increased Maguntsche Demon's Attack Cooldown by 4%

-Increased Maguntsche Demon's Primary Damage by 20%

notes.title: The Further Descent Update is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/581ce5a314b9f2803892f7dfa513d8b518000be5.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40443391/46fb71e3d35c20aac90731e759033f6113b467d9.png[/img]

This August, prepare yourself to descend deeper into The Realmverse than ever before! In the Further Descent Update, launching later this month, you'll have the opportunity to explore some new game mechanics that will diversify each of your play sessions. It came to our attention that the archives system lost its touch because each playthrough was the same. This is something we are continuing to work on in the future, but we decided to polish up the initial experience before beginning work on the game's Superior Mode. To celebrate, Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered will also be going on sale! Below you'll find a list of improvments and new features coming in this update!

[b]New Environment Variability![/b]

In this update, some of the Realmverse iterations will be randomized from a predetermined set of generated levels. We currently are working on adding three new variations to two iterations of the game. This means that there will be [u]28 unique level combinations[/u] to explore! We hope this will encourage both new and existing players to collect and complete the Maguntsche Archives.

[b]New Flashlight Mechanics![/b]

It was decided that they player needed some way to defend their self. The player's flashlight will have new functionality that will allow them to "burn" the Maguntsche Demon. This causes him to slow down temporarily which will make navigating the house a bit easier. However, this comes at the expense of quickly annoying the Maguntsche Demon, which will cause him to enter a frenzy where he is immune to the flashlight, moves more quickly, and deals more damage.

[b]New Environment Interactions![/b]

The player now can interact with several objects within the house. This not only provides some additional exploration opportunities for the player, but also allowed us to expand a bit on the game's story and information about the player's character!

[b]New Achievements![/b]

As an additional touch to the revised experience, we're working on adding some new achievements for some of our more determined players. Some of these achievements are more challenge oriented, and will be more difficult to complete compared to our original set of achievements.

[b]Added In-Game Settings Menu[/b]

You now will have the ability to change the game's settings from within the pause menu! This was a highly requested improvement that we've now brought to completion after a handful of smaller updates. We remain open to suggestions for future settings / localization options. 

[b]Additional Polishes & Improvements[/b]

In this update, you'll also find some fixes to existing issues and glitches. We are also working on improving the visual aspects of the game further by improving some of the materials. We remain open to any suggestions that you may have for the future!

notes.title: Patch [0.1.4]
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This small update includes some necessary improvements to the Maguntsche Demon's respawning mechanic as well as some new changes to improve the overall experience. Below you can see a list of changes in this update. It will be live shortly after this announcement.

[h1]Update [0.1.4] Patch Notes[/h1]


[b]Fixed Maguntsche Demon Stair Bug[/b]

We finally were able to fix this issue that would give the game free hits on the player. In our last update, we initially thought simply readjusting the spawn point would resolve the problem. It was brought to our attention that this was not the case and that the mechanic was still broken in some circumstances. After some digging into the issue, we were able to resolve the fundamental issue of how this mechanic was set up and he now should no longer spawn on the stairs.


[b]Resolved In-Game Text Inconsistency[/b]

We had some minor issues with the references to certain objectives in-game. They since have been resolved. We hope this provides some additional clarity on how to play the game.


[b]What's Coming Next?[/b]

This is likely to be the last patch before our next major update. With the feedback we've received, we are going to focus on delivering some changes to the game's core mechanics to allow some variation in both the environment and the spawn locations of the Reality Fragments. This will ultimately make the experience of collecting entries for the Maguntsche Archives a more pleasing experience. If you have any additional things you'd like to see in the future, please let us know!

Resolved In-Game Text Inconsistency

notes.title: Patch [0.1.3]
notes.content:
Just a small update with some new improvements regarding new brightness settings and some other additional balance-based changes. This update will be available shortly after this post.

[h1]Update [0.1.3] Patch Notes[/h1]


[b]New In-Game Brightness Settings[/b]

Players now have the ability to adjust the game's brightness from the settings menu or pause menu. The changes we made with The Lights Out Update required user control for the overall brightness of the environment.

[b]Reconfigured & Polished Glitch Screen Visuals[/b]

These effects have been slightly reduced to avoid eye strain. The code associated with the effects has also been reconfigured to improve the accuracy of the effect being triggered by the player looking at the enemy. We also added some additional glitch sound FX to this event.

[b]Fixed Ending Screen Bugs for Larger Display Resolutions[/b]

We also fixed a bug regarding the display of text on all of the ending screens. Originally, displays with larger resolutions would cause overlapping of the text associated with each game ending. The text now scales properly for all three endings.

[b]Balanced Flashlight Mechanics[/b]

We added an additional 40 seconds of use to the flashlight. We removed the UI elements associated with the flashlight temporarily and reconfigured the controls for the flashlight. Players will now use the Primary Mouse Button to toggle the flashlight.

[b]Balances to Maguntsche Demon Behavior[/b]

The Maguntsche Demon now has a new spawn point that will prevent him from attacking the players on the stairs after collecting artifacts. This was originally an unfair advantage to the game as it would give free hits. We also pulled back on his attack distance threshold slightly from the previous change. This means he will have to be in closer contact to deal damage.

notes.title: The Lights Out Patch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're back with another update and we've got some exciting changes coming. In this small update, we are making some changes to the environmental lighting. We wanted to make the world seem darker to better reflect the original experience released back in 2018. It was brought to our attention by some players that the current setup is too bright. We're still working on the next major update, but we decided to pass a smaller one with some spooky changes. Below you'll find a better description of this change as well as some other improvements and bug fixes. This update will be going live shortly after this announcement.


[h1]The Lights Out Update [0.1.2] Patch Notes[/h1]


[b]Darkened Environmental Lighting & Effects[/b]

In addition to making the main scene slightly darker, we've also implemented some fog mechanics. When in the Normalverse, this fog isn't as dense. However, when in the Realmverse the density of this fog increases during the player's transition. We believe the environment is too small to be able to have full visibility. This will not only provide a scarier experience, but it will also become a more challenging one.

[b]Implemented New Flashlight Mechanics[/b]

We decided to reduce the overall brightness and radius of the flashlight slightly to help make the environment darker once again. You'll also find that the flashlight now has a limited capacity and once drained will no longer work. We are exploring other options to expand the functionality of the flashlight in future updates.

[b]Disabled Glow Appearance for Maguntsche Demon[/b]

While we initially liked the idea of having the main enemy glow in the dark, we now feel that it makes him too visible while in the Realmverse. Not only will this make the game more challenging, but it is also more similar to the source material of the first game.

[b]Fixed Backroom Step Bug[/b]

We've changed some of the level design elements so that players no longer get stuck in the door frame between the backroom and the kitchen.

[b]Fixed Blink Mechanic Animation[/b]

We discovered an issue thanks to players regarding the blinking mechanic on displays with larger resolutions. This has now been fixed and should work correctly.

notes.title: The Launch Week Update!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback during our first week on Steam! I had said previously that the quality of our project is something that we will strive to improve. Below, you'll find some small improvements and additions that will hopefully provide a more comfortable and enjoyable experience to both new and returning players! This update will be pushed shortly after this announcement!


[h1]The Launch Update [0.1.1] Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Camera Sensitivity Settings[/b]

Players will now be able to set their preferred camera sensitivity from either the settings panel in the main menu or through the pause menu in-game. The default camera sensitivity has also been lowered. We are currently working on providing access to more settings from the pause menu to improve ease of access.

[b]Maguntsche Demon Behavior Balancing[/b]

We've discovered through watching players that the difficulty scaling is too easy. We believe this is why so many players are currently able to move through the campaign quickly and why some people believe they aren't getting a complete experience. You'll find that the Maguntsche Demon now deals more damage through his attacks. We also increased the distance threshold for his attacks so that his animations are more visible to the player. His default speed has also been slightly increased.

[b]Reality Shards Improvements [/b]

Players will now receive an auditory notification when they interact with the reality shards. You will also notice that these objects have been given animations now to make them seem more dynamic.

[b]Player Stamina Balancing[/b]

We have also updated the total amount of stamina that the player has. It was observed that the stamina given to the player was excessive and allowed the player to outrun the enemy fairly quickly. Due to the fact that the stamina regenerates so quickly, the challenge of balancing the player's energy was absent. We've decided to start with a 25% decrease in total stamina and will adjust accordingly with additional feedback.

[b]Minor Tutorial Improvements[/b]

We've made some minor changes to the Controls section of the Tutorial panel. If you are having trouble understanding the game, we highly recommend you check out this section! It provides information regarding specific interface elements and mechanics you'll encounter in-game.

[h1]What's Coming Next?[/h1]

Through gathering feedback, we understand some of the frustration with the game's replayability. While we are planning a content update this Fall with a new game mode, we wanted to do something for players sooner to make the experience more dynamic. We are looking at adding some additional randomness to each playthrough.

[b]The next major update will include a set variety of potential spawns for each of the reality shards in three of the Realmverse iterations. [/b]

Further, into the future, we'd like to explore more alternative environment designs for each of the Realmverse iterations. That way each playthrough is always a new experience while attempting to collect archive entries. That brings us to the end of this update! Thank you everyone for your support and stay tuned for more updates in the near future!

Best Regards - GlassDev
